body.publicationId: existing gid://shopify/Publication/N, required for publish only

response.operation: original publication operation; query route instead returns publication.operations/latest
response.status: preparing | pending_approval | approved | denied | stale | running | partial | uncertain | succeeded | blocked

displayRules.draftSuccess: businessCompletion draft_only, never display as published
displayRules.publicationSuccess: businessCompletion published requires exact-channel verified receipt
displayRules.partial: show issues and original product ID; cannot auto-retry missing writes
displayRules.uncertain: retain original operation and request; offer read-only reconcile
displayRules.replay: keep exact original requestId and body after local response loss
displayRules.scopeChanged: refresh/query and explicitly review current scope; never reinterpret an old confirmation
displayRules.approval: use domain decision route; generic approval decision rejects the binding
displayRules.oldShopifyDraftRoute: remains non-writing; old confirmation cannot create a Shopify product
displayRules.media: source SHA and remote IDs/READY are separate; remoteBytesVerified is false
displayRules.publicationTime: selected arbitrary channel publishedAt is null; onlineStorePublishedAt is separate
displayRules.firstRealAcceptance: not run; fixture responses are never live execution evidence

code: selected-channel notifications and exact-source traffic integration are in continued development
